Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class AiFeatureNames

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.AiFeatureNames
public final class AiFeatureNames extends Object
Canonical string identifiers for AI-powered recruitment features in the TA system.

These keys are passed via LmRequest.getFeatureName() and used by MockLmClient to route deterministic mock responses, by AI service classes for prompt construction and logging, and as stable contract values across the LM integration layer. Prefer these constants over literal strings so feature names stay consistent between servlets, services, and mock routing.

This class is not instantiable; use the public static final constants only.

See Also:
